thesis: The speakers argue that the healthcare industry suffers from a lack of price transparency, where hospitals inflate prices to gain negotiating leverage with insurers, creating an opaque system unlike the airline industry. They contend that making prices visible for the 60% of shoppable services would drive quality transparency and honest competition, despite the complexities of individual patient contexts and the current dominance of consolidated providers.
